interpretation: The immutable-send Proxy failure is a test-driver defect independent of the original hidden-panel behavior tracked as EXT-D-0133. The native run used version 0.2.257 rather than the required 0.2.244, so it is not a controlled comparison for EXT-D-0133.
cause: traceOrganizationPointers proxied the real panel and replaced its non-configurable, non-writable own send property in the get trap, violating the JavaScript Proxy invariant before organization selection could send a command.
repair: The recorder proxies an independent facade, delegates commands and other methods to the original panel receiver, and brackets only mouse dispatches with pointer markers.

red_proof.result: two failures before repair: immutable panel receiver mismatch and actual Scrape wiring Proxy invariant

green_proof.result: 6 passed, 0 failed after repair; includes frozen panel, original receiver and errors, non-mouse delegation, pointer markers, and actual Scrape setup wiring

sibling_census: The only panel/connection send-intercepting Proxy in tests/browser is traceOrganizationPointers; no sibling wrapper has the same invariant pattern.
limits: Focused local test proof only. No native run or browser acceptance was performed in this repair lane.
